Four original measured snapshots at 3.003, 9.0035, 12.001 and 18.6505 T. The 9T frame is a separate execution of the same controller/configuration, not an interpolated frame. BodySDF=0 and Lambda2 contours use the recorded smoothing, thresholds and common color scale.

Group learning_curves.csv by replicate_id and condition and draw cumulative best valid distance-integral scores from iteration 0 through 40. All five naive_seed experiments (naive_1 through naive_5) and all five two_dimensional_champion experiments (transfer_1 through transfer_5) are shown. Thin curves show individual experiments; the thick curve is the complete experiment with the median final score in its condition (naive_3 and transfer_3), not a pointwise median. Failed evaluations have no plotted score and remain recorded in the raw score index. Supporting tables retain all 40 final-iteration candidates, endpoint calculations and point-level score origins.
